- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Alta Peak Trail is a challenging 13-mile out-and-back hike that offers breathtaking views of the Sierra Nevada mountains and the Great Western Divide.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Marble Falls Trail is a moderate 4-mile out-and-back hike that leads to a beautiful waterfall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Big Trees Trail is an easy 1.5-mile loop perfect for families or leisurely strolls.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The High Sierra Trail is a strenuous 72-mile trail that takes you from the Giant Forest to the summit of Mount Whitney.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Moro Rock Trail is a short, steep 1/4-mile hike that offers panoramic views.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Long Meadow Trail is a moderate 2.5-mile loop that explores a beautiful meadow.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Before heading out, the user should check the park's website for up-to-date trail information and any necessary permits or restrictions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should bring plenty of water, sunscreen, and snacks, as services can be limited in the park.
